QuestInfo.name: [Dance] Shall We Dance?
QuestInfo.0: Lilin is in a rut, practicing the same dance moves over and over. See if Gaga has any ideas.
QuestInfo.1: This Funky Machine will record all of your moves for 30 minutes. Will that help?
QuestInfo.2: You don't know how useful this machine is, but it was worth the experience, right?

0.0: We have a problem, #b#h0##k. I know you have been helping #rLilin#k with her practice, but she's in a slump with her dancing. She keeps practicing the same moves, but I don't think her heart is in it. Can you find a way to help her?

yes.0: Lilin needs inspiration to come up with some new moves, and she want to use you for that, #b#h0##k. Put this Funky Machine in your Set-up Inventory, and it will record every move you make. Just carry on normally, #b#h0##k. Lilin wants to draw inspiration from your everyday moves.
yes.1: The motion capture will be completed in #r30 minutes#k. After that, you have #b3 hours#k to take the Funky Machine to #rLilin#k. Oh, and if you #blog out during this process#k, you could lose all your recordings! Okay, #b#h0##k, go to it!

no.0: Really? She's counting on you, and you're refusing to help? If you say so...

npc.0: You can meet Lilin by taking the Dimensional Mirror to the Rising Star Hall.

item.0: This Funky Machine doesn't quite seem...funky enough yet.
